Description
This 2020 Audi e-tron Sportback has been fastidiously maintained within the Audi dealer network at Audi Lincoln from new. The EV battery remains under Audi warranty until 2028 offering peace of mind for the coming years. As this is the higher performance 55 version, the driver will experience a smooth and refined drive whilst accelerating from 0 to 60mph in a swift 5.7 seconds with an equivalent of 408 BHP, demonstrating its dynamic capability. This model comes equipped with over £9000 worth of extras and desirable features, including a Panoramic Glass Sunroof, which looks stylish and creates an airy cabin area and ambient lighting which creates a range of varied looks to the overall interior space. The Comfort and Sound Package enhances convenience with keyless entry and a 360 degree camera for parking assistance. Further enhancing safety and awareness are Virtual Door Mirrors and Audi Side Assist, which includes blind spot assistance. The premium B&O sound system delivers a fantastic acoustic experience and with the Tour Pack extras along with the generous boot space, it is practical for everyday use and longer trips. The orange brake callipers fitted behind the S-Line 21" Alloy wheels subtly add to the overall aesthetic of this stunning looking vehicle. As an electric vehicle with Four Wheel Drive, this S line variant combines advanced technology with impressive performance. It features a substantial 95 kWh battery, providing a maximum range of over 200 miles when new. Charging is convenient as even rapid public charging can take you from empty to 80% in just 40 minutes.
